preconditions.description: The length of the passage P is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for c in P)
preconditions.description: The characters in the passage P are either '#' or '.'.
The first and last characters of P are '#'.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= days_to_cross[i] <= len(P) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of days it takes them to cross the passage is between 1 and the length of the passage.
